description: Nielsen, Jesper Ellerbæk at Aalborg University publishes measurements of air-water stratified flow in a poorly ventilated sewer main through Co-UDlabs. The Aalborg FREJLEV transnational-access experiment investigates interactions between liquid flow and sewer gas. A DATA archive is accompanied by the campaign report and data-management document. Coverage is the FREJLEV sewer-main test site; exact campaign dates, sensor positions and sampling intervals are unspecified. Zenodo provides a data archive and descriptive documentation with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is gas species, measurement variables and boundary conditions cannot be reconstructed from the short native description. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
